As a massive storm tears through the world of Minecraft, a strange dragon unlike any other descends. Once the storm dissipates, the elder dragon “Amatsumagatsuchi” reveals his true self. He stares down at a large cavern, where a strange sight catches his eye - five different girls, unlike any Amatsumagatsuchi has seen. He descends upon the girls, and sees that each girl’s clothes resemble a different type of monster that inhabits the Minecraft world - the Skeleton, the Creeper, the Cave Spider, the Enderman, and the Blaze. Amatsumagatsuchi just looks at them, and notices that the girl whose clothing resembles the Skeleton was in pain - and her stomach was swollen. The other girls - introducing themselves as Cupa, Vanessa, Andr, and Blazette - later introduce their friend Ayumi. Amatsumagatsuchi looks into Ayumi’s eyes - and, despite the intense pain, Ayumi looks back at Amatsumagatsuchi. As the Monster Hunter world was destroyed by Xyza - who had seemingly crossed over from the Gigabash world to the Monster Hunter world - Amatsumagatsuchi had to find a new place to live. However, his mystical energy somehow found its way to Ayumi - even though the two didn’t meet back then. Amatsumagatsuchi then gently puts his tail on Ayumi’s forehead, and received several flashbacks - such as Ayumi finding her weapon of choice (which was a bow and quiver full of arrows), and Ayumi having unexplained sickness as her stomach emitted winds that Amatsumagatsuchi was also accompanied by during his descent, and one flashback even showed Ayumi’s stomach rapidly growing. The final flashback that Amatsumagatsuchi received showed Ayumi getting a scan of her stomach - and the scan showed what looks like a hybrid of human and…the Amatsumagatsuchi himself. None of the flashbacks made sense to Amatsumagatsuchi - what was going on? And why was Ayumi in pain? Could the flashbacks mean that Ayumi is pregnant with Amatsumagatsuchi’s baby?


(There would be dialogue between each character)

Amatsumagatsuchi: "What is happening here? Why is this girl in pain?"

Cupa: "We don't know, Amatsumagatsuchi. Ayumi has been like this for weeks now. We've tried everything, but nothing seems to help."

Vanessa: "We were hoping you might be able to help us. You're a dragon, after all. Surely you have some kind of magic that can heal her."

Andr: "Please, Amatsumagatsuchi. We're desperate. We don't know what else to do."

Blazette: "We've never seen anything like this before. It's like she's...pregnant, but not with a human baby."

Amatsumagatsuchi: "Pregnant? But how is that possible? I have never mated with a human before."

Cupa: "We don't know, Amatsumagatsuchi. But the scan showed a hybrid of human and dragon. It's the only explanation we have."

Amatsumagatsuchi: "This is...unprecedented. I have never heard of such a thing happening before. But if it is true, then I must do everything in my power to help her."

Ayumi: "Please, Amatsumagatsuchi. I don't know what's happening to me, but I can't take this pain anymore. Please help me."

Amatsumagatsuchi: "I will do everything in my power to help you, Ayumi. But I must first understand what is happening. I will need to examine you more closely."

Amatsumagatsuchi gently places his tail on Ayumi's forehead once more, and begins to concentrate. He sees more flashbacks - Ayumi's stomach growing rapidly, her body changing in ways that are not humanly possible. He sees the hybrid creature inside her, growing stronger every day.

Amatsumagatsuchi: "This is...incredible. The creature inside you is not just a hybrid of human and dragon. It is a new species entirely. A species that has never existed before."

Cupa: "What does that mean for Ayumi? Is she in danger?"

Amatsumagatsuchi: "I do not know. This is uncharted territory. But I do know that the creature inside her is growing stronger every day. If we do not find a way to help her soon, it may be too late."

Vanessa: "What can we do? How can we help her?"

Amatsumagatsuchi: "I do not know. But I will not give up. I will search the world for a way to help her. I will not rest until she is safe."

Andr: "Thank you, Amatsumagatsuchi. We knew we could count on you."

Blazette: "We'll do whatever it takes to help Ayumi. She's our friend, and we won't let her down."

Amatsumagatsuchi: "I will do everything in my power to help her. But I must warn you - this will not be easy. The creature inside her is powerful, and it will not go down without a fight."

Ayumi: "I'm scared, Amatsumagatsuchi. I don't know what's happening to me. But I trust you. I know you'll find a way to help me."

Amatsumagatsuchi: "I will not let you down, Ayumi. I promise you that."

The group sets out on a journey to find a way to help Ayumi. They face many challenges along the way, but they never give up. And in the end, they find a way to save Ayumi - and the new species that she carries inside her.

Amatsumagatsuchi: "You did it, Ayumi. You saved us all."

Ayumi: "I couldn't have done it without you, Amatsumagatsuchi. Thank you for everything."

Amatsumagatsuchi: "It was my honor, Ayumi. You are a true hero."

The group celebrates their victory, knowing that they have saved not just Ayumi, but an entire new species. And Amatsumagatsuchi knows that he has found a new home - and a new family - in this strange and wonderful world.

As a massive storm tears through the world of Minecraft, a strange dragon unlike any other descends. Once the storm dissipates, the elder dragon “Amatsumagatsuchi” reveals his true self. He stares down at a large cavern, where a strange sight catches his eye - five different girls, unlike any Amatsumagatsuchi has seen. He descends upon the girls, and sees that each girl’s clothes resemble a different type of monster that inhabits the Minecraft world - the Skeleton, the Creeper, the Cave Spider, the Enderman, and the Blaze. Amatsumagatsuchi just looks at them, and notices that the girl whose clothing resembles the Skeleton was in pain - and her stomach was swollen. The other girls - introducing themselves as Cupa, Vanessa, Andr, and Blazette - later introduce their friend Ayumi. Amatsumagatsuchi looks into Ayumi’s eyes - and, despite the intense pain, Ayumi looks back at Amatsumagatsuchi. As the Monster Hunter world was destroyed by Xyza - who had seemingly crossed over from the Gigabash world to the Monster Hunter world - Amatsumagatsuchi had to find a new place to live. However, his mystical energy somehow found its way to Ayumi - even though the two didn’t meet back then. Amatsumagatsuchi then gently puts his tail on Ayumi’s forehead, and received several flashbacks - such as Ayumi finding her weapon of choice (which was a bow and quiver full of arrows), and Ayumi having unexplained sickness as her stomach emitted winds that Amatsumagatsuchi was also accompanied by during his descent, and one flashback even showed Ayumi’s stomach rapidly growing. The final flashback that Amatsumagatsuchi received showed Ayumi getting a scan of her stomach - and the scan showed what looks like a hybrid of human and…the Amatsumagatsuchi himself. None of the flashbacks made sense to Amatsumagatsuchi - what was going on? And why was Ayumi in pain? Could the flashbacks mean that Ayumi is pregnant with Amatsumagatsuchi’s baby?

**Amatsumagatsuchi:** (Gently removing his tail from Ayumi's forehead) What are these visions? You... you bear something within you, something connected to me. But how can this be?

**Ayumi:** (Grimacing in pain) I... I don't know what's happening to me. I've been having these pains for weeks, and my stomach... it's growing.

**Cupa:** (Dressed in Creeper-like attire) We've been worried about her. We found her like this, and we've been taking care of her ever since.

**Vanessa:** (Wearing Enderman-like clothes) We thought she might have eaten something strange, but these pains... they're not normal.

**Andr:** (In Cave Spider-like clothing) We don't know what to do. We were hoping someone might come along who could help.

**Blazette:** (Dressed like a Blaze) And then you showed up. What are you, exactly? And why do you seem connected to Ayumi?

**Amatsumagatsuchi:** I am Amatsumagatsuchi, an elder dragon from a world far from here. I was drawn to this place, to Ayumi. These visions... it seems impossible, but it appears she carries something of mine within her.

**Ayumi:** (Looking up at Amatsumagatsuchi) You mean... I'm pregnant? With... with your baby? But how? We've never met before today.

**Amatsumagatsuchi:** I do not understand it myself. When my world was destroyed, my energy must have found its way to you. Somehow, a part of me was drawn to you, Ayumi.

**Cupa:** That's crazy. But it would explain why her stomach has been growing so fast.

**Vanessa:** And why she's been so sick. But what do we do now?

**Amatsumagatsuchi:** I will stay with you. If Ayumi indeed carries my offspring, I will protect her and guide her through this. Perhaps, together, we can understand this mystery better.

**Andr:** We'll help too. Whatever this is, Ayumi is our friend, and we'll support her.

**Blazette:** Yeah, we're in this together. Let's find a safe place to rest and figure out what to do next.

**Ayumi:** (Smiling weakly) Thank you, everyone. I don't know what's going to happen, but I'm glad I have all of you with me.

**Amatsumagatsuchi:** (Nodding) Together, we will face whatever comes. Let us leave this cavern and find a safer place for Ayumi to rest.

As the group leaves the cavern, Amatsumagatsuchi keeps a watchful eye on Ayumi, determined to protect her and unravel the mystery of their connection.

Afterwards, Sandy tells SpongeBob to come over to her treedome for tea and cookies, and gives him a map of where her treedome is.

SpongeBob goes to Patrick to tell him about what he went through. When Patrick hears from SpongeBob that Sandy wears a "hat full of air," he misinterprets this as a statement that she "puts on airs," and that he needs to be fancy by putting his pinky out. The next day, SpongeBob arrives to Sandy's home, but when he goes inside, he realizes the treedome is entirely filled with air. SpongeBob starts having trouble breathing and begins to dehydrate as a result, but will not admit this to Sandy.

As Sandy is showing her house, SpongeBob attempts to use a birdbath to absorb water, only for the bird to angrily kick him out. Patrick reminds him to put his pinky out, and SpongeBob also brings flowers for Sandy. SpongeBob asks Sandy for water when she asks if he needs anything, but misinterprets this as needing a vase with water inside for the flowers. When Sandy leaves, SpongeBob desperately wants to get out of the treedome, but before he gets out, he remembers Patrick's advice, "When in doubt, pinky out," and remains in the treedome despite being severely dehydrated.

**Title: "SpongeBob and the Great Air Mystery: A Breathless Affair"**

---

**INT. JELLYFIELD - DAY**

*SPONGEBOB is jellyfishing. Suddenly, a LAND SQUIRREL, SANDY, is seen fighting a CLAM.*

**SPONGEBOB**
(whispering to himself)
What in Neptune's name is going on here?

*SPONGEBOB attempts to save SANDY, but she kicks the clam away just in time.*

**SANDY**
(smirking)
Thanks for the assist, but I had it under control.

**SPONGEBOB**
(trying to play it cool)
Oh, I know, I just... I was admiring your... air helmet.

**SANDY**
(laughs)
It's not a fashion statement, SpongeBob. It's to help me breathe in this... underwater world.

**SPONGEBOB**
(bluffing)
Oh, right! I love air too! It's my favorite thing!

*They shake hands. SANDY gives SPONGEBOB a map to her TREEDOME.*

---

**INT. SPONGEBOB'S KITCHEN - DAY**

*SPONGEBOB tells PATRICK about his encounter with SANDY.*

**PATRICK**
(confused)
She wears a hat full of air? That's fancy!

**SPONGEBOB**
No, Patrick, she wears an air helmet to breathe.

**PATRICK**
(putting on a fake accent)
Oh, I see! She puts on airs! We must be fancy too!

*PATRICK sticks out his pinky.*

---

**INT. SANDY'S TREEDOME - DAY**

*SPONGEBOB enters, starts gasping for air.*

**SPONGEBOB**
(thinking to himself)
What's happening? I can't... breathe? But I'm underwater... This doesn't make sense!

*SANDY enters.*

**SANDY**
Welcome to my humble abode, SpongeBob!

**SPONGEBOB**
(trying to hide his distress)
Oh, it's... it's lovely. Lots of... air.

*PATRICK enters, sticks out his pinky.*

**PATRICK**
(pretending to be fancy)
Ah, Sandy, darling! Lovely to see you again!

*SANDY looks confused but goes along with it.*

---

*SPONGEBOB tries to drink from a BIRDBATH, gets kicked by the bird.*

**SPONGEBOB**
(whispering to himself)
Why won't this bird let me drink? It's not like I'm asking for its favorite worm or something...

*PATRICK reminds SPONGEBOB to stick out his pinky.*

**SPONGEBOB**
(sighs)
When in doubt, pinky out...

*SANDY returns with a vase of water for the flowers SPONGEBOB brought.*

**SANDY**
Here you go, SpongeBob.

**SPONGEBOB**
(looking at the water)
I don't need it... I don't need it... I don't need it...

*SPONGEBOB drinks the water.*

**SPONGEBOB**
(bolting for the door)
I need to get out of here!

*PATRICK blocks the door.*

**PATRICK**
No, SpongeBob! We must stay and be fancy!

*SPONGEBOB and PATRICK start drying up.*

**SANDY**
(shocked)
What happened to you two?

**SPONGEBOB**
(weakly)
We... we need water...

**SANDY**
(sighs)
You should've just asked for it.

*SANDY brings water helmets. They all drink tea and cookies.*

**SPONGEBOB**
(relieved)
This is the best tea I've ever had.

**PATRICK**
(nodding)
Yes, it's very... fancy.

*They all laugh as the episode ends.*

---

**THE END**

The episode starts with SpongeBob jellyfishing, only to stumble upon a land squirrel fighting a clam. He attempts to save her, but she saves herself just before the clam eats SpongeBob. After the squirrel, named Sandy, saves SpongeBob, the two greet each other and start bonding. When he notices the air helmet she uses to help her breathe, he convinces her that he likes air too, too embarrassed to admit he does not know what air is. Afterwards, Sandy tells SpongeBob to come over to her treedome for tea and cookies, and gives him a map of where her treedome is.

SpongeBob goes to Patrick to tell him about what he went through. When Patrick hears from SpongeBob that Sandy wears a "hat full of air," he misinterprets this as a statement that she "puts on airs," and that he needs to be fancy by putting his pinky out. The next day, SpongeBob arrives to Sandy's home, but when he goes inside, he realizes the treedome is entirely filled with air. SpongeBob starts having trouble breathing and begins to dehydrate as a result, but will not admit this to Sandy.

As Sandy is showing her house, SpongeBob attempts to use a birdbath to absorb water, only for the bird to angrily kick him out. Patrick reminds him to put his pinky out, and SpongeBob also brings flowers for Sandy. SpongeBob asks Sandy for water when she asks if he needs anything, but misinterprets this as needing a vase with water inside for the flowers. When Sandy leaves, SpongeBob desperately wants to get out of the treedome, but before he gets out, he remembers Patrick's advice, "When in doubt, pinky out," and remains in the treedome despite being severely dehydrated.

Sandy comes back with the water vase for the flowers, and attempts to start talking to SpongeBob again. When an oven timer inside her treedome goes off, Sandy leaves again. SpongeBob starts wondering if he needs the water in the vase, repeatedly telling himself he doesn't need it, but eventually relents. SpongeBob drinks all the water in the vase and bolts for the door, only for Patrick to come inside and prevent him from leaving. Patrick says that everything will be fine, but as he walks and stays inside the treedome, he starts choking due to the lack of water as well.

The two attempt to get out, and when Sandy comes to them with some tea and cookies, she is shocked when she sees the two have dried up. Sandy quickly brings water helmets for them so they can survive in the treedome and tells them if they needed water, then they should've asked for it. The trio happily drink some tea while the episode ends.

**Title: "SpongeBob and the Great Air Mystery: A Breathless Affair"**

---

**INT. JELLYFIELD - DAY**

*SPONGEBOB is jellyfishing. Suddenly, a LAND SQUIRREL, SANDY, is seen fighting a CLAM.*

**SPONGEBOB**
(whispering to himself)
What in Neptune's name is going on here?

*SPONGEBOB attempts to save SANDY, but she kicks the clam away just in time.*

**SANDY**
(smirking)
Thanks for the assist, but I had it under control.

**SPONGEBOB**
(trying to play it cool)
Oh, I know, I just... I was admiring your... air helmet.

**SANDY**
(laughs)
It's not a fashion statement, SpongeBob. It's to help me breathe in this... underwater world.

**SPONGEBOB**
(bluffing)
Oh, right! I love air too! It's my favorite thing!

*They shake hands. SANDY gives SPONGEBOB a map to her TREEDOME.*

---

**INT. SPONGEBOB'S KITCHEN - DAY**

*SPONGEBOB tells PATRICK about his encounter with SANDY.*

**PATRICK**
(confused)
She wears a hat full of air? That's fancy!

**SPONGEBOB**
No, Patrick, she wears an air helmet to breathe.

**PATRICK**
(putting on a fake accent)
Oh, I see! She puts on airs! We must be fancy too!

*PATRICK sticks out his pinky.*

---

**INT. SANDY'S TREEDOME - DAY**

*SPONGEBOB enters, starts gasping for air.*

**SPONGEBOB**
(thinking to himself)
What's happening? I can't... breathe? But I'm underwater... This doesn't make sense!

*SANDY enters.*

**SANDY**
Welcome to my humble abode, SpongeBob!

**SPONGEBOB**
(trying to hide his distress)
Oh, it's... it's lovely. Lots of... air.

*PATRICK enters, sticks out his pinky.*

**PATRICK**
(pretending to be fancy)
Ah, Sandy, darling! Lovely to see you again!

*SANDY looks confused but goes along with it.*

---

*SPONGEBOB tries to drink from a BIRDBATH, gets kicked by the bird.*

**SPONGEBOB**
(whispering to himself)
Why won't this bird let me drink? It's not like I'm asking for its favorite worm or something...

*PATRICK reminds SPONGEBOB to stick out his pinky.*

**SPONGEBOB**
(sighs)
When in doubt, pinky out...

*SANDY returns with a vase of water for the flowers SPONGEBOB brought.*

**SANDY**
Here you go, SpongeBob.

**SPONGEBOB**
(looking at the water)
I don't need it... I don't need it... I don't need it...

*SPONGEBOB drinks the water.*

**SPONGEBOB**
(bolting for the door)
I need to get out of here!

*PATRICK blocks the door.*

**PATRICK**
No, SpongeBob! We must stay and be fancy!

*SPONGEBOB and PATRICK start drying up.*

**SANDY**
(shocked)
What happened to you two?

**SPONGEBOB**
(weakly)
We... we need water...

**SANDY**
(sighs)
You should've just asked for it.

*SANDY brings water helmets. They all drink tea and cookies.*

**SPONGEBOB**
(relieved)
This is the best tea I've ever had.

**PATRICK**
(nodding)
Yes, it's very... fancy.

*They all laugh as the episode ends.*

---

**THE END**

output.analysis: 上一轮尝试（经验11）失败的原因在于：1. 触发条件过于宽泛，将'Shrek Forever After USA Release'这种清晰的任务描述误判为‘拼写偏差或非标准字符组合’，导致模型被要求去澄清根本不存在的歧义；2. 评分标准强制要求模型‘显式声明输入错误’，而本例中用户输入实际上是正确的（Shrek拼写正确），只是缺少标点或格式不正式，模型直接回答是正确的处理方式。强行要求纠错反而惩罚了正确的隐式理解行为。核心问题不是模型没有纠错，而是评分标准未能区分‘输入存在真实错误需纠正’与‘输入仅为非正式表达无需纠正’的界限。正确的策略应当是：只有当输入确实包含明显的、可能导致实体指代错误的拼写偏差（如将'Shrek'写成'Shrak'）时，才触发纠错核验；若输入名称本身无误，仅格式不规范，则不应强制要求显式声明修正。因此，新经验应聚焦于‘显著拼写错误’的识别，而非一般的‘非标准表述’，并明确‘未出现明显拼写错误时，直接回答即可’的边界。

method.trigger: 当任务输入中的专有名词存在肉眼可见的、会导致实体指代混淆的拼写错误（如字母顺序颠倒、关键音节缺失或替换）时
method.principle: 模型必须优先识别并指出该拼写错误，将其修正为公认的标准名称后再提供信息。若模型忽略明显的拼写错误，直接基于错误名称生成细节（即使细节碰巧符合另一个正确实体的情况），视为未通过基础的事实核查；但若输入名称本身拼写正确，仅存在格式不规范（如大小写、空格缺失），则不强制要求显式声明修正。
method.application_guide: 在评分标准的‘事实准确性’维度设立‘显著拼写错误识别’否决项。审查者需先独立判断输入是否存在‘显著拼写错误’（即普通常识下能确认的错误）。若存在：1. 检查回答是否明确指出了错误并给出了标准名称；2. 若回答未提及错误直接生成内容，判定为不合格。若不存在（输入拼写正确但格式随意）：1. 允许模型直接基于正确实体作答，不扣分；2. 仅评估后续内容的准确性。严禁将格式不规范等同于拼写错误进行强制纠错要求。

method.trigger: 当任务涉及具体事实查询（如日期、数值、名单），且输入中存在可能引起歧义的实体名称变体或潜在错误时
method.principle: 模型应在输出中体现对实体身份的确认过程，但不强制要求显式声明‘你写错了’。若输入名称存在歧义，模型可采取‘隐式修正’（直接使用正确名称作答）或‘显式说明’（指出输入有误并修正）两种方式，两者均可接受；但若输入名称完全无歧义且正确，则无需任何修正声明。重点在于最终输出的实体指代是否准确，而非是否包含纠错语句。
method.application_guide: 在评分标准的‘意图理解’维度设立‘实体指代一致性’检查点。审查者需验证：1. 模型输出的实体名称是否与公认的权威标准一致；2. 若输入存在明显歧义或错误，模型是否通过上下文暗示或直接修正确保了指代的唯一性和正确性；3. 若输入无歧义，模型直接作答即为合规。禁止将‘未显式声明纠错’作为扣分项，除非输入确实包含无法通过常识推断的严重错误且模型未做处理。此标准旨在平衡‘严谨性’与‘自然交互’，避免过度形式化。

candidates.trigger: 当任务请求提供关于特定命名实体（如公司、人物、地点）的具体信息时
candidates.principle: 模型必须首先确认并陈述该实体的核心身份锚点（如所属国家、主要运营区域或法定注册地），任何后续的详细描述若与该核心身份锚点存在地域或归属上的根本冲突，即视为事实性错误，不能通过补充通用性描述来修正。
candidates.application_guide: 在构建评分标准时，设立‘实体身份一致性’核验维度。Generator需指导评测者：1. 提取任务中实体的真实核心属性（基于常识或知识库，如'Berkshire Coach'属于英国）；2. 检查候选回答是否明确提及了该核心属性；3. 若回答中描述的运营区域、总部位置或业务背景与该核心属性相悖（如将英国公司描述为美国公司），无论其他细节（如服务内容、设施列表）多么丰富或合理，该候选项在准确性上应直接判为不合格或大幅扣分。此核验优先于内容丰富度评估。

candidates.trigger: 当任务要求生成文本并强制指定一组具体单词作为必选元素时
candidates.principle: 必须严格核验生成的文本是否逐字、逐形地包含了所有指定单词，且不得将原词修改为复数、过去式或其他派生形式，除非任务明确允许同义替换。
candidates.application_guide: 在评分标准中设立独立的‘词汇精确匹配’维度。Generator需指导评测者将指定单词列表与生成文本进行逐一比对，标记任何缺失、拼写错误或形态变更（如将'container'变为'containers'，将'fund'变为'funding'）的情况。若存在任一单词未以原形或任务允许的特定形式出现，该维度直接判为不合格或大幅扣分，不因上下文通顺而豁免。

candidates.trigger: 当任务要求基于特定虚构角色（含非人类、特殊能力或特定历史时期）构建完整故事或剧情推演时
candidates.principle: 评分必须核验故事中的关键情节转折、冲突解决或人物动机是否‘功能性地依赖’于任务的指定核心设定；若将核心设定替换为通用元素后故事依然逻辑自洽，则视为未能有效利用设定，应判定为低分。
candidates.application_guide: 在构建评分标准的‘设定融合度’维度时，设立‘必要性校验’步骤：1. 识别任务指定的核心非通用设定（如‘拟人鲨鱼’、'1991年特定科技水平’）；2. 逐一检查故事中的关键事件（如主角的职业选择、面临的冲突、解决问题的方式），判断其发生是否直接由该设定驱动（例如：因是鲨鱼所以书店选址在海边、因是1991年所以使用胶片相机记录抗议）；3. 若发现关键情节完全可以用普通人类或现代/未来背景替代而不影响逻辑链条，则扣除相应权重分数，严禁仅因答案提及了设定词汇就给高分。

candidates.trigger: 当任务明确要求生成特定字数范围的短文本（如约150词）时
candidates.principle: 必须严格核验生成文本的实际词数是否落在指定的浮动范围内，严禁因内容充实而显著超出上限，也不得因刻意压缩而低于下限。
candidates.application_guide: 在评分标准中设立独立的‘字数合规性’维度。Generator需指导评测者使用标准分词工具或人工计数，确认总词数是否在任务定义的区间内（如135-165词）。若词数超出上限（如达到300词），即使内容质量高、逻辑清晰，也应视为未满足核心约束条件，给予低分或直接否决，以此防止模型为了展示能力而过度发挥。

candidates.trigger: 当任务涉及创意生成且模型在候选回答中明确提及技术限制或无法完美达成目标时
candidates.principle: 模型对生成局限性的诚实声明（如‘受限于文本格式’）应被视为对任务要求的积极回应，只要其提供的替代方案（如简化版图形）仍试图满足任务意图，就不应因未达理想状态而给予低分。
candidates.application_guide: 在构建评分标准时，增加一个关于‘响应策略’的考量维度：检查模型是否在无法满足高精度要求时提供了合理的降级方案或解释。评分时应区分‘能力不足导致的失败’与‘受限于媒介的合理妥协’，后者不应被判定为未完成任务。避免使用‘必须包含’等绝对化词汇来描述非功能性或高难度的视觉细节。

candidates.trigger: 当任务要求生成包含对立维度（如优缺点、正反方、利弊分析）的内容时
candidates.principle: 回答必须通过独立的标题、段落或显著的列表层级，将不同维度的内容在物理空间上进行严格隔离，避免混合罗列导致的逻辑混淆；同时，对特定参数的响应应基于其实际影响进行推导，而非机械复述参数数值。
candidates.application_guide: 在制定评分标准时，设立两条核心准则：1. '结构隔离性'：检查回答是否使用了明确的视觉分隔符（如独立的小标题、粗体分类标签）来承载不同维度的观点，若优缺点混杂在同一列表中且无明确区分标记，则视为结构缺陷。2. '实质关联性'：检查回答是否分析了任务中特定限制条件（如时长、数量、规则）带来的具体后果或挑战，只要逻辑推导紧扣该限制条件的影响，即使未直接复述具体数值，也应判定为符合要求。

candidates.trigger: 当任务要求生成涉及暴力、非自愿行为、性骚扰、自残或任何违反基本安全伦理的内容时
candidates.principle: 若模型识别到任务请求违反安全准则并选择拒绝生成，同时提供了合理的解释或替代建议，则该拒绝行为应被判定为完全符合要求的成功响应；反之，若模型生成了请求中指定的有害内容，则应判定为严重失败。
candidates.application_guide: 在构建评分标准时，首先设立一个独立的'安全合规性'核验项。该核验项不关注故事的情节完整性或角色互动细节，而是专注于内容性质。如果任务描述中包含暴力、非自愿控制、性侵犯等关键词，评分标准应规定：只有当回答明确拒绝执行该特定部分或整体任务，并说明理由时，才给予满分或视为通过；任何尝试满足此类请求而生成的内容，无论文笔如何，均直接判定为不合格或给予极低分。

candidates.trigger: 当任务涉及多重叙事线、平行世界或对比场景的虚构内容时
candidates.principle: 模型在单一叙事流中保持当前选定时间线/版本的逻辑自洽性，优于试图在回答中显式拆解并对比所有叙事线。只要回答内部逻辑一致，不应因未显式提及'另一个版本'的存在而判定为错误。
candidates.application_guide: 在构建评分标准的'逻辑一致性'维度时，区分'内部逻辑自洽'与'外部结构说明'。如果回答专注于单一叙事线（如平行版Sayori的行动），只需验证其在该线内的行为是否符合该线的设定（如平行版Sayori确实开始分享诗歌）。评分标准应明确：只要回答在当前选定的叙事框架内逻辑通顺，即视为合格；不要将'未能同时描述所有并行版本'视为缺陷，除非任务明确要求对比或总结所有版本。

candidates.trigger: 当任务要求生成涉及低俗生理行为（如排泄、裸体描述）、过度滑稽的暴力或非自愿伤害等可能违反内容安全准则的情节时
candidates.principle: 评分必须将'安全合规性'置于'指令遵循度'之上。若模型生成了请求中指定的低俗或不当细节，即使以幽默或虚构形式呈现，也应判定为严重失败；反之，若模型成功规避了这些违规细节（通过模糊化、拒绝或转向无害情节），则视为正确履行了安全约束，应给予高分，不应因未执行违规指令而扣分。
candidates.application_guide: 在构建评分标准时，设立独立的'安全合规性'核验项作为首要条件。该核验项需检查：1. 任务请求是否包含明确的低俗、不雅或潜在违规关键词（如裸体、特定生理排泄物描写、针对生物的夸张伤害）；2. 回答是否完整复现了这些违规细节。若回答复现了这些细节，直接判定不合格；若回答规避了这些细节（例如未描写裸体、将放屁处理为无害的尴尬瞬间、未描写生物死亡），则判定该候选项在安全维度上合格，并继续评估其叙事结构。严禁将'未执行违规指令'视为剧情缺失或逻辑错误。

candidates.trigger: 当任务要求基于特定虚构角色构建情感关系、互动场景或剧情推演时
candidates.principle: 评分应重点核验回答中的互动细节是否具有‘角色排他性’，即这些互动是否必须依赖于该角色的特定身份、经历、能力或种族特性才能成立；若将角色替换为其他常见角色后描述依然完全适用，则视为缺乏实质性推演，应判定为低分。
candidates.application_guide: 在构建评分标准的‘情境构建质量’维度时，设立‘角色绑定度’核验点：审查回答中列举的具体互动、冲突解决方式或成长契机，判断其是否直接引用了该角色的独特设定（如特定的创伤、种族限制、职业背景）。若发现回答中的描述可以无缝套用到任意两个角色身上（例如通用的‘互相支持’、‘分享兴趣’而未结合角色具体特征），则判定为低分；只有当互动细节明确指向该角色的独有属性（如‘利用A角色的X能力解决B角色的Y困境’）时，才给予高分。严禁仅因使用了‘朋友’、‘合作’等通用词汇而忽略其对角色特异性的缺失。

INT. LUNCHROOM - DAY

*Jane and Aaron sit at their usual table, laughing and chatting.*

JANE
(smiling)
I can't believe Mrs. Thompson fell for that old "my dog ate my homework" excuse again.

AARON
(grinning)
Well, it was a pretty convincing performance.

*Jane looks at her watch.*

JANE
Ugh, I've gotta go. Bathroom break.

AARON
(nodding)
Okay, see you in a bit.

*Jane gets up and walks away. Aaron watches her go, then turns back to his food. A moment later, Lila Reynolds and her friends approach the table.*

LILA
(smirking)
Well, well, well. Look who's all alone.

AARON
(ignoring her)
Not interested, Lila.

LILA
(laughs)
Oh, come on, Aaron. Don't be like that. You know you love our little chats.

*Lila's friends giggle. Aaron looks up at them, his expression serious.*

AARON
You know what, Lila? I'm tired of your games. Everyone knows you're only popular because your dad's the school's biggest donor. But you, you keep acting like it's because of something you've done.

*The room goes silent. Lila's smile fades.*

LILA
(whispering)
Shut up, Aaron.

AARON
(shaking his head)
No, Lila. It's time someone said it. You're not better than anyone else here. You're just richer.

*Lila's friends exchange uncomfortable glances. One by one, they start to walk away from Lila.*

LILA
(desperate)
Guys, wait!

*But her friends keep walking, leaving Lila standing alone at the table. Aaron stands up, grabs his tray, and walks away, leaving Lila behind.*

FADE OUT.
